d: Not all robots are created equal. Waterproof robots reign supreme. Get a FREE solar powered iSkim ($499 value) when you buy a BeatBot Aquasense X HERE: (Official Website) The Beatbot Aquasense X is able to operate autonomously underwater for 5 hours at a time to clean a pool. Using AI it can differentiate between 40 different objects, AND clean multiple platforms and steps underwater. Today we are going to see how the BeatBot Aquasense X is built - so that our off road tracked wheelchairs can survive better in streams and beaches.
